overview_description.description: PromptArmor develops an AI risk management platform that helps organizations assess and monitor security risks across third-party AI systems. Its platform continuously analyzes large language model interactions, detects prompt injection and data exfiltration threats, and provides technical intelligence and risk scoring, enabling enterprises to strengthen AI governance, compliance, and vendor security.

product.name: PromptArmor AI Risk Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that assesses and monitors AI-related risks in third-party vendors for risk management teams.

product.name: PromptArmor AI Risk Quantification Engine™
product.description: A proprietary engine that quantifies AI risks for vendors, mapping them to security frameworks and estimating monetary impact.

product.name: AI Vendor Identification
product.description: A service that identifies vendors using AI within an organization and maps associated risks.

product.name: Continuous AI Risk Monitoring
product.description: A feature providing real-time updates on AI-related changes affecting data, privacy, or security risk posture.

product.name: Executive AI Risk Dashboard
product.description: An executive-level dashboard that reports on AI-related vendor risks and risk gaps across the organization.

product.name: AI Executive Education Course
product.description: An educational program that trains and certifies teams on AI security risks and risk management.
